description: Turn a place name into the exact latitude, longitude and IANA timezone needed by compute_natal_chart and compute_transits, using Astrolog's own database of ~100,000 cities. ALWAYS call this instead of supplying coordinates or a timezone from memory: the timezone determines the Ascendant and every house cusp, so a plausible but wrong zone produces a confidently wrong chart. Returns several candidates when a name is ambiguous (there are many Springfields, and a Paris in Texas) — show them to the user and let them choose rather than picking one. Returns an empty list when nothing matches, in which case ask the user for a larger nearby city or the country, and do NOT fall back to remembered coordinates.

query.description: Place as the user said it, e.g. "Lyon", "Springfield, Illinois", "Bogota".
